description: The headless tree core of the SvGrid UI kit in Svelte 5. createTree is the runes state machine behind SvTree: flattening the node tree into visible rows, expand and collapse, single selection, cascading tri-state checkboxes and the full keyboard, exposed as treeProps and itemProps. One core drives the styled SvTree and a custom compact file explorer, both bound to a single selected id.

faq.question: What does flattening give my render?
faq.answer: An array of visible rows with depth, expanded state, selection and check state per node, so a render is a simple each block over rows rather than a recursive component.

faq.question: What does itemProps wire?
faq.answer: role treeitem, aria-level, aria-expanded and aria-selected, the click and double-click handlers and the keyboard: Up and Down move, Right expands, Left collapses, Enter selects.

faq.question: Do cascading checkboxes come from the core?
faq.answer: Yes. Checking a node updates its descendants and recomputes ancestors to checked, unchecked or partial, and both renders read the result.
